scope: B1: paginated project and material library with server search

library.data: isolated local services; 1006 projects and 1006 materials, synthetic account
checks: bounded metadata, real visible previews, next-page failure keeps items and retry appends without duplicates
project list and global server search open the poster older than the legacy 1000-item cutoff
folder count/filter and recently opened name sort use complete server state
late search response cannot replace the current query results
failed server search stays an error and retry restores the matching result
old uploaded material found by server search is placed into a real saved poster
favorite material outside the initial page remains visible alongside the built-in favorite
brand and reference pickers search the entire material library and pin immutable versions
existing Studio material picker also uses paginated server search
paged project library reflows at desktop/tablet/mobile/breakpoints and 200% equivalent viewport

poster.data: isolated local regression database and storage; real services, synthetic account
checks: template → direct Editor → edit text → save → reload
project list and global search reopen the same editor
real renderer job downloads a 600 × 800 PNG
upload → save brand → apply font/colors and immutable Logo in editor
uploaded material is placed into the editable poster
stock reference creates a poster without INVALID_ASSET
text-only reference keeps the brief and creates no bogus asset link
lost create response retries with the same idempotency key and no duplicate project
tools reflect published operations and existing Studio projects retain their entry
home reflows at desktop/tablet/mobile, 320px, breakpoints and 200% equivalent viewport
390px blank poster creation, add text, edit and save through mobile panels

development.tunnel: default chisel; E2B loopback Web 200 and API health ok

limitations: No mail provider configured in repository, Codex bindings or production app.env key inventory
Visible project previews still load authoritative documents; thumbnail image cache and large-document budgets deferred
Literal substring search tested on 1000+ records, not a large-scale performance SLA
No physical mobile keyboard, screen reader, live model or backup recovery exercise
visualReview: Desktop 1440px and mobile 390/320px screenshots reviewed; narrow category labels remain whole and wrap as buttons.
